policy: Reuse all288existing complete negative diagnostic waveforms, not score-filtered; both known training-source voices/fournearword prefixes/fourcarriers/three speeds/three conditions. Explicitly transfer these training-related diagnostic examples to training for the next fixed experiment; never call them independent development or acceptance thereafter. Preserve original diagnostic evidence. No new TTS, PCM rendering/cropping, wake inference or protectedfinal access. Extract fullwave frontend UINT16 features once to a small memmap; keep source hashes/labels/provenance. Goal and candidate independent acceptance remain incomplete.
